name: Svelte Chicago - March 2026
description:
🏙️ **Come hang out with us at Svelte Chicago!**

Interested in Svelte? Join us for pizza, beverages, and networking at the [M1 Finance](https://m1.com) office for the next meeting of the Chicago chapter of Svelte Society!

📄 Web Serialization and SvelteKit: JSON.stringify, Devalue, and Beyond

Devalue is the client-server serialization library used by SvelteKit. In this talk, [Robert Ismo](https://www.linkedin.com/in/robertismo/) will go over why we want serialization libraries, the what and why of devalue, and the current limitations of devalue and other solutions.

🕖 **Agenda**

- Pizza and networking at 5:30pm
- Introductions at 6:15pm
- Web Serialization and SvelteKit at 6:30pm
- More networking
- At 8pm, you don't have to go home, but you can't stay there

Special thanks to [M1 Finance](https://m1.com) for hosting and [Storyblok](https://www.storyblok.com/) for sponsoring!
